# sonarqube_rule (Data Source)

Looks up a rule by key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_rule" "s3776" {
  key = "java:S3776"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Rule key, e.g. `java:S1144`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this lookup in Terraform state.
- `is_template` (Boolean) Whether the rule is a template that custom rules (`sonarqube_rule`) are created from.
- `language` (String) Language key.
- `markdown_description` (String) Description of a custom rule; null for built-in rules, which use description sections.
- `name` (String) Rule name.
- `params` (Map of String) Parameter defaults by name.
- `repo` (String) Rule repository key.
- `severity` (String) Default severity (`INFO`, `MINOR`, `MAJOR`, `CRITICAL` or `BLOCKER`).
- `status` (String) Rule status (`READY`, `BETA`, `DEPRECATED` or `REMOVED`).
- `template_key` (String) Template of a custom rule, or null.
- `type` (String) Rule type (`CODE_SMELL`, `BUG`, `VULNERABILITY` or `SECURITY_HOTSPOT`).
